defect: the Substrate master program writes modules into src/mop/cognition inside the live temporal core worktree. The temporal supervisor refuses any shard launch while git reports src dirty, so uncommitted Substrate files made a required startup stage fail and the supervisor returned. launchd does not restart a clean exit, so it stayed down until noticed
correction: the incident is recorded in the temporal orchestration ledger as substrate_program_dirty_src_supervisor_exit_20260727.json. SUBSTRATE_STATE.json now reports source_tree_clean, computed from git, so a state file written from a dirty tree carries that fact rather than hiding it. The operating rule is that Substrate edits land in commits before the supervisor next needs to launch anything
reproduced_by: observed live at 2026-07-27, supervisor exit on mop.temporal.runs.codelife with two untracked src/mop/cognition files; eight principal workers survived and were re adopted on restart
rule: a reproduced defect overrides reviewer votes and becomes a permanent regression test
